name: Code
description: A block of source code with an optional title, line numbers, marked lines, syntax colors, copy and collapse.

children.description: Source text, shown line by line and copied verbatim; a final line break ends the last line instead of adding an empty one.

language.description: Language of the source, set as the `language-*` class of `<code>` for highlighters; Code itself does not color the text.

tokenizedLines.description: Syntax colors from a highlighter, one token array per line of `children`; a line whose tokens spell other text renders plain.

title.description: Header text such as a file name; without it a one-line source keeps its copy button beside it instead of a header.

showLineNumbers.description: Number each line in a gutter that is never selected, copied or read aloud.

highlightedLines.description: Numbers of the lines to mark, whole and from 1; each renders as a highlighted `<mark>`.

collapsed.description: Controlled collapse: a source longer than `collapsedLines` shows only its first lines and cannot scroll; a shorter one always shows in full.

collapsedLines.description: Lines a collapsed source shows, an integer from 1; a source with no more lines cannot collapse.

labels.description: Names of the copy and collapse buttons and the copy confirmation.

props.title: Files / Playground
long-snippet.ts

notes: Code is an approved mono-content exception and intentionally uses mono typography tokens.
Title and action labels route through Text/Button; tokenizedLines may carry syntax-highlighter colors as source-code data.
A collapsed source is exactly collapsedLines line boxes tall (1lh each plus --uf-code-pad above and below), capped by --uf-code-scroll-max-height.
--uf-code-collapsed-lines is written inline on the pre from the collapsedLines prop; it is not a theme token.
